messages:
zara: Heads-up: p95 for /v1/completions-preview jumped at 07:42. p50 steady, p99 unchanged. Anyone else seeing discrepancy?

omar: I saw that. It coincided with a small routing tweak for quota fallbacks.

leah: Which dashboard view? realtime or historical? We have tdigest rollups in realtime and exact for history, they can disagree.

zara: Realtime tile. Query: `env:prod service:inference endpoint:/v1/completions-preview | percentile(latency_ms,95) by endpoint, route`

metrics-bot: Alert: p95(/v1/completions-preview) > 200ms at 2026-03-29 07:42:12  samples=312

mike: Quick split by route+variant gives main p95=120ms count=290, fallback p95=380ms count=22. Combined p95 in exact view = 130ms, realtime shows 215ms.

omar: Small noisy cohort effect + aggregator mismatch. Classic.

leah: Suggestion: rollout panel should expose variant-level pcts and sample_count. Also show which aggregator the tile uses and a low-sample warning when count < 50.

zara: Agree. Ops also wants a tiny time-series for fallback_fraction so triage sees routing changes without extra queries.

mike: Action items: Omar will add variant rows to the rollout card, Leah will add aggregator label + low-sample badge, Zara will add fallback_fraction tile to endpoint dashboard.

omar: I'll open a small UI PR today. ETA EOD.

leah: I'll update the alert template to include sample_count and a computed "cohort_influence" = combined_p95 - p95_excluding_small_routes.

metrics-bot: Note: telemetry README should document tdigest vs exact differences and advise showing sample_count on percentile tiles.

zara: Thanks all, hope this reduces noisy pages. :thumbsup:
